name: Brave Browser Automation & Code Testing Engine
description: Enables ALIEN to take direct actions inside Brave Browser: open & navigate URLs, inspect pages, extract text, click elements, fill forms, execute JavaScript, and run in-browser code tests via the ALIEN Browser Extension.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Visit or open a website in Brave Browser. Can open in a new tab or update the current active tab.

url.description: The destination URL (e.g. https://github.com or http://localhost:3000)

new_tab.description: Whether to open in a new tab (default true)

tools.name: browser_get_content
tools.description: Extract the readable text, title, links, and buttons from the active page in Brave Browser.

max_length.description: Maximum characters of text to retrieve (default 6000)

tools.name: browser_eval_js
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code directly in the active Brave tab and return the evaluated result.

code.description: JavaScript code snippet or function to evaluate

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element or button on the active Brave page by CSS selector or visible text.

text.description: Visible button or link text to match if selector is omitted

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an input field or textarea on the active Brave page.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input field

text.description: Text to type into the field

clear.description: Whether to clear existing text before typing (default true)

tools.name: browser_run_code_test
tools.description: Execute and test JavaScript or web code inside Brave Browser, capturing logs, assertion results, and performance duration.

code.description: JavaScript test code to execute in the browser

test_name.description: Name or purpose of the test (e.g. 'DOM Render Test', 'API Fetch Verification')

tools.name: browser_list_tabs
tools.description: List all open tabs in Brave Browser with their IDs, titles, and URLs.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the visible area in the active Brave tab.
